faq.q: Is it my fault when a friendship changes?
faq.a: Usually it is nobody's fault. People grow, change classes or find new hobbies. If you think you upset your friend, you can ask kindly and say sorry if needed.
asks: Why did my best friend leave me?

faq.q: Who can I talk to when I miss a friend?
faq.a: A parent, grandparent, teacher or school counsellor. Talking about sad feelings with someone you trust makes them feel lighter.
asks: Who can help when I feel lonely?

faq.a: Yes. Even if you spend less time together, you can still say hi, share news and be friendly. Some friendships come back stronger later.
asks: Can we still be friends if we are in different classes?

faq.q: How do I make new friends after a friendship ends?
faq.a: Try a club, team or activity you enjoy. People who like the same things as you are easy to talk to.
asks: Tell me about the Try a new club

faq.q: Is it okay to have more than one best friend?
faq.a: Yes. You can have different friends for different things, like a football friend and a reading friend.
asks: Can I have two best friends?

facts: Studies of school children find that many close friendships change from one school year to the next, which is a normal part of growing up.
Joining clubs, teams and hobby groups is one of the most common ways people of every age make new friends.
